scout.purpose: Content rendering and input combine typography, localisation, keyboard behaviour, selection, accessibility, and configuration-aware resources.
scout.realWorldUse: Every form, search field, image, icon, and message must display current state and remain usable across locales, font scales, keyboards, and restoration.
scout.outcome: Render resource-backed text and images, build a controlled text field, and distinguish decorative from meaningful content semantics.

sections.title: Text is content plus typography and semantics

blocks.text: Text receives a String or annotated text and a TextStyle that can come from MaterialTheme typography. User-visible application strings should use stringResource or pluralStringResource so translations can reorder arguments and apply quantity grammar. Avoid fixed line counts that clip large fonts unless truncation is a deliberate disclosed interaction. AnnotatedString supports multiple spans and annotations, while LinkAnnotation and appropriate components provide accessible links. Selection, copy, and text layout may matter for learning code and long lessons. Test pseudo-locales, RTL, and large font scale rather than assuming one English screenshot represents the content.

blocks.caption: The field renders caller state, reports edits, and exposes validation without owning domain policy.

rows: Action description such as Save note
Visible icon plus identical text label
User data, not translated app resource

sections.title: Text fields are controlled state machines

blocks.text: A TextField is controlled: value is the current state and onValueChange reports proposed edits. If the callback does not update state, the field appears read-only. Hoist business-relevant input to the screen state holder; simple local UI input can remain near the field and use rememberSaveable when restoration matters. Choose keyboardOptions and keyboardActions from the semantic input, but validate independently because keyboards are hints, paste bypasses them, and hardware input differs. Show error state and supporting text from validation state without mutating during composition. For advanced selection and composition handling, use the appropriate text-field state APIs instead of repeatedly replacing text.

blocks.code:
val message = pluralStringResource(R.plurals.note_count, notes.size, notes.size)
Text(message, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge)
blocks.caption: Plural resources let the locale select grammar while substituting the count.

blocks.title: Keyboard type is not validation
blocks.text: IME configuration improves input but all external text still needs domain validation.

sections.title: Resources and images adapt to environment

blocks.text: painterResource loads drawable resources, while image-loading libraries handle remote or decoded images outside this foundation. Icon vectors should follow tint and direction behaviour; use auto-mirrored directional icons. contentDescription is null for purely decorative imagery already explained by adjacent text, and concise for meaningful images or icon-only actions. Modifier.size controls layout size while ContentScale controls how image content fits bounds. Do not decode large bitmaps in a composable body. Resolve current resources in composition so locale/night changes update naturally, and keep stable domain identity separate from translated display labels.

Production work on text, input, images, and resources should begin with an observable requirement rather than a preferred API. Exercise the normal path, empty and error states, recreation, long content, large font scale, and rapid repeated input where they apply. Keep ownership visible in function signatures, make cancellation and failure behaviour deliberate, and record any assumption that crosses a lifecycle or platform boundary. Use previews for visual state, focused unit tests for pure transformations, Compose UI tests for semantics and interaction, and device traces or inspection tools only when runtime evidence is required. The goal is not merely code that renders once; it is behaviour another engineer can explain, test, change, and recover after the operating system or user changes the conditions.

trap_check.why: Paste, hardware input, and IME behaviour can bypass the hint.

trap_check.mistake: Giving every image a content description.
trap_check.why: Decorative or duplicated content creates noisy accessibility output.
trap_check.fix: Describe only meaningful information or action.

challenge_intro.task: Create title/body inputs with saved state, validation, keyboard actions, plural character feedback, and correct icon/image semantics.
challenge_intro.successLooksLike: Fields remain controlled across recreation. All application text comes from resources and handles large fonts. Validation does not rely on keyboard type.

recall.prompt: Why can a controlled field look frozen?
recall.answer: Its onValueChange path does not publish a new value.
Use plural resources with locale-aware quantity selection.
When imagery is decorative or already equivalently represented.
